title: The Library Cushion by the Low Shelf
youtube_title: The Library Cushion by the Low Shelf | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: What is split with care does not become less important.
summary: At a school cloakroom and the lunch mats just beyond, Esme sees that a library cushion beside the low shelf will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Esme makes a smaller, even share so Bibi is included, and Uncle Idris lets the choice stand without a speech.
